verdict.rationale: Maritime publishes dedicated framework pages for Claude Code and Codex. The Claude Code page says it runs in its own always-on micro-VM with persistent storage and chat channels. The Codex page says it works without a user key via Maritime's metered LLM access. Ready-made framework templates deploy pre-configured with one image pull. missing for 10: step-by-step detail of the actual recipes in the evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration that these coding-agent templates run as described.
